metricHints.clicks: All clicks on the campaign, including repeat clicks from the same visitor.
metricHints.uniqueClicks: Clicks from unique visitors — repeat visits by the same person are not counted.
metricHints.conversions: Number of conversions (target actions) tied to clicks.
metricHints.revenue: Revenue from conversions in USD at the rate on the event date, net of chargebacks: a declined FTD is subtracted on the day of the decline.
metricHints.cost: Traffic spend in USD. Taken from manually entered cost; shown as “—” when there is none.
metricHints.roi: ROI = (revenue − cost) ÷ cost × 100%. How many percent of the spend came back on top of it.
metricHints.roas: ROAS = revenue ÷ cost. Dollars of revenue per 1 dollar of spend.
metricHints.ctr: CTR = landing views ÷ clicks × 100%. The share of clicks that reached a landing view.
metricHints.cvr: CVR (conversion rate) — the share of clicks that ended in a conversion: conversions ÷ clicks × 100%.
metricHints.cpc: CPC = cost ÷ clicks. Average price of one click.
metricHints.cpa: CPA = cost ÷ conversions. Average price of one conversion.
metricHints.epc: EPC = revenue ÷ clicks. Average revenue per click.
metricHints.registrations: Registrations at the network — CPA_HOLD events.
metricHints.clickToInstall: PWA installs ÷ clicks × 100%. "—" when there are no clicks.
metricHints.installToReg: Registrations ÷ PWA installs × 100%. "—" when there are no installs.
metricHints.regToPurchase: Purchases ÷ registrations × 100%. "—" when there are no registrations.
metricHints.costPerInstall: Cost ÷ PWA installs. "—" without cost or without installs.
metricHints.costPerReg: Cost ÷ registrations. "—" without cost or without registrations.
metricHints.costPerPurchase: Cost ÷ purchases. "—" without cost or without purchases.
metricHints.blocked: Clicks that matched no destination (no flow and no fallback) and were not redirected — SOURCE_FILTER events. They are not counted in Clicks.
metricHints.bots: Clicks flagged as bots by the classifier, including bots that were still sent to a fallback.
metricHints.blockedRate: Blocked ÷ (clicks + blocked) × 100%. "—" when there was no traffic.
metricHints.botRate: Bots ÷ (clicks + blocked) × 100%. "—" when there was no traffic.
